text:
nina: Heads upI've opened a draft PR to update the audit log migration guide for tenant identifiers -> tenant_hash. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/513 (WIP). Need final SOC 2 phrasing and a short SDK migration snippet.
sam: paste the old example so i can see what to change.
nina: Old example in docs: 
```json
{"tenant_id": "tenant_42", "actor": "bob@example.com", "event": "login"}
```
ash: For compliance copy, use 'pseudonymized' if there's a reversible mapping. If irreversibly hashed, say 'irreversibly pseudonymized' or 'hashed' and mention salt. 
dana-legal: Legal prefers explicit: 'tenant identifiers are pseudonymized using a salted hash; mapping tables, if any, are strictly access-controlled and access is logged.' Also ask to add retention default language.
sam: Good. Also add a short python SDK example replacing tenant_id with tenant_hash and an inline note: "do not log raw tenant identifiers".
ci-bot: Preview build for PR 513: https://deploy.previews.redwood/513 build OK
nina: Proposed doc paragraph: \"Audit logs record tenant identifiers as salted hashes (tenant_hash). Mapping tables are restricted and access is logged for auditing and incident response. Audit exports are encrypted at rest. Default log retention is 90 days; customers can configure retention on export.retention_days.\" Thoughts?
sam: Shorten 'mapping tables are restricted' -> 'mapping tables are access-restricted' maybe.
dana-legal: Please include 'audited access' phrase: 'access-restricted and subject to audited access controls.' Also we prefer 'SHA-256 with secret salt' mention rather than just 'salted hash' so auditors see the algorithm.
ash: Add a one-line migration note that client libraries will surface tenant_hash in v2.1 and to rotate salts if you rotate keys.
nina: Updated PR with snippet:
```python
# pseudonymize before sending
import hashlib
raw = b"tenant:acme"
tenant_hash = hashlib.sha256(b"somesalt" + raw).hexdigest()
client.audit.log_event(tenant_hash=tenant_hash, actor=None, event='login')
# do not include raw tenant_id in logs or exports
```
sam: auditors like to see 'secret salt' stored separately (KMS). Add note: 'Salt must be stored securely (e.g., KMS) and rotated per policy.'
dana-legal: LGTM after adding KMS note. Also ask to add a tiny FAQ: 'Why tenant_hash?' -> privacy + minimizes PII in logs.
ci-bot: Link checker found two broken anchors in api-reference: audit-exports -> fixed in follow-up commit.
nina: added FAQ and KMS sentence, fixed anchors, added changelog entry under migration notes v2.1. CI green.
sam: once legal approves phrasing i will merge. Any more blockers?
dana-legal: Approved. Please keep conservative phrasing.
nina: merging now. :shipit:
sam: thanks all.
ash: added small follow-up commit: recommend rotating salts on key rotation and provide contact for enterprise customers about migration assistance.
nina: closing thread. Thanks everyone.
